caption:
Who does Allah make beloved to His creation?

Allah tells us that the Most Compassionate will endear those who believe and do righteous deeds. A promise worth working toward, one good deed at a time.

Surah Maryam 19:96

Which righteous deed will you do quietly today?

#beloved #righteousdeeds #surahmaryam #muslimhabits
